title: computeConsensus Loop Optimization
description: The _buildAndCompute function loops over revealedValidators performing storage reads for reputation and commit data per validator. Each iteration includes expensive reputation calculation with decay math.
impact: Gas-intensive operation in critical path for finalizing contributions. Scales linearly with validator count.
recommendations: Cache reputation calculations outside the loop when possible
Use memory arrays for frequently accessed validator data
Consider batched reputation updates to reduce SLOAD operations

title: ConsensusLib Math Operations Optimization
current_usage: ~80k gas for weighted average + std dev
description: High-precision arithmetic with PRECISION = 1e18 multiplier for weighted average and standard deviation calculations. Multiple division operations and square root computations.
impact: Core consensus computation is computationally expensive. Affects all contribution finalizations.
recommendations: Use fixed-point arithmetic with lower precision where acceptable
Pre-compute common values outside loops
Consider lookup tables for common sqrt(stake) values

title: expireClaim Loop Storage Operations
description: Loop over claim.indices performs multiple SLOAD/SSTORE operations per index: IndexState reads, returnStack writes, and status updates.
impact: Keeper operation that processes multiple indices. Gas cost scales with claim size.
recommendations: Batch storage writes using memory arrays and single SSTORE operations
Use struct packing to reduce storage slot access
Cache frequently accessed storage variables outside the loop

title: Deep Mapping Access Patterns
description: Validator commit mappings use 4-level nesting: projectId => index => nonce => validator => ValidatorCommit. Each access requires multiple JUMP operations.
impact: All validation operations incur higher gas costs due to deep storage traversal.
recommendations: Consider keccak256 hashing for multi-level keys to reduce mapping depth
Use struct composition to group related data
Pre-compute common key combinations

title: Vault Call Batching in expireClaim
description: expireClaim makes single slashAndUnlockContributor call, but multiple claims could be batched by keepers.
impact: Keeper operations could be more efficient with batching.
recommendations: Implement batchExpireClaims function for keepers
Add multi-user vault operations to reduce call overhead
Use UserOperation batching at account abstraction layer

title: Reputation Calculation Optimization
current_usage: ~2k gas per reputation read with decay
description: Reputation calculation includes time-based decay computation with division operations on every access.
impact: Called frequently in consensus computation loops. Affects validator weighting.
recommendations: Cache decayed reputation values with timestamps
Use lazy decay updates only when reputation changes
Pre-calculate reputation for active validators

title: Compiler Optimizer Runs Increase
savings_estimate: ~5-15% reduction in contract bytecode size and execution gas
description: Current optimizer_runs = 200 is conservative. Higher values can find better optimization opportunities.
impact: All contract operations benefit from better optimization.
recommendations: Increase optimizer_runs to 1000 for production deployment
Test gas costs with different optimizer_runs values
Monitor bytecode size impact (should not exceed block limits)

title: Memory vs Storage Usage in Loops
current_usage: Memory arrays for weights and inputs
description: ConsensusLib creates multiple memory arrays (weights, inputs) that scale with validator count.
impact: Memory allocation overhead in consensus computation.
recommendations: Reuse memory arrays where possible
Use fixed-size arrays for common validator counts
Pack data structures to reduce memory expansion costs

title: Cold Storage Access in Critical Paths
description: Storage slots may not be warm when accessed, incurring 2100 gas instead of 100 gas for warm access.
recommendations: Order operations to warm storage slots before heavy access
Group related storage reads together
Consider caching frequently accessed data in memory

title: Struct Packing Optimization
description: ValidatorCommit struct uses 3 storage slots but could be packed into 2 slots with better field ordering.
impact: All validator commit and reveal operations.
recommendations: Reorder fields to maximize slot packing
Use uint types that fit remaining slot space
Consider trade-offs between read frequency and packing efficiency
